correctness.rationale: Strongest headline claim (DRAFT.md theorem): (a) exactly 2 STS(13) types with Pasch 13 (cyclic, |Aut|=39) and 8 (non-cyclic, |Aut|=6), from 14400 canonical-prefix completions split 1920/12480; (b) two named STS(15) witnesses: anti-Pasch 0-Pasch |Aut|=60 and PG(3,2) 105-Pasch |Aut|=20160, pairwise non-isomorphic, 105 as attained reference not global maximum. Decisive replays all PASS: bundled verify.py gives 28/28 VERIFY_OK (STS validity, both Pasch counters, Aut orders, SHAs, non-isomorphism). Independent fresh checker (no artifact imports) reproduces Pasch 13/8/0/105 via definition-level 4-subset 6-point-union count; fresh backtracking reproduces Aut 39/6/60 and both non-isomorphism verdicts; stored PG32 list byte-equals direct F2^4-lines construction and GL(4,2) order is 15*14*12*8=20160. Full census13.py re-executed from scratch (~88 s): 14400 solutions, 1920 C13 / 12480 T2, same Pasch/Aut/SHAs. Canonical-prefix lemma reviewed: FIXED 7-block partial STS is valid (21 pairs); every STS(13) has a point plus an off-point block meeting 3 distinct pencil blocks (26>6 blocks), so every type embeds F (also computationally confirmed F embeds in C13). Pasch-counting lemma (4 STS blocks on 6 points => max degree <=2 since 3 concurrent blocks span 7 points, hence all degrees =2) is sound; both counters agree on every committed list and pasch_fast asserts count%6==0. Exact-cover solver is standard deterministic MRV enumeration; classification tests every solution against representatives so exactly-2-types follows from 1920+12480=14400 with 0 others. Minimality of 0-Pasch witness rests only on global lower bound 0, not on search. Honest scoping: full 80-class STS(15) spectrum and maximality of 105 are explicitly NOT claimed. DRAFT SHA notation mixes system-SHAs with file-SHAs but verify.py checks resolve unambiguously and match stored JSON. No essential inference, boundary condition, or computation fails.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/failed-search: classical catalog counts (2 STS(13), 80 STS(15), e.g. Cole-era enumerations) do not imply per-class Pasch numbers. Nearest sources checked live: Demirkale-Donovan-Grannell arXiv:1708.07646 confirms 80 STS(15) ~100 years old and reports Pasch/mitre/Fano only for new 16/17-point maximum partial systems, not the 13/15 per-class spectrum; Ling-Colbourn-Grannell-Griggs (doi:10.1112/s0024610700008838) gives general anti-Pasch constructions with v=7,13 exceptions (so STS(13) min>=1 is prior, but exact 13/8 is not implied); Kaski-Ostergard STS(19) classification records Pasch per design at order 19 (2591 anti-Pasch among ~11B), not the 13/15 slice; Prazmowska-Prazmowski arXiv:1403.4916 gives weaving-product anti-Pasch series, not an exhaustive spectrum; Baldwin arXiv:2201.11566 is model-theoretic infinite anti-Pasch existence, far from finite census; Grannell-Griggs-Mendelsohn (doi:10.1002/jcd.3180030107) proves Pasch count determines other 4-line counts but supplies no values; Mogilnykh-Soloveva (doi:10.1109/sibircon.2017.8109876) treats Mollard-family Pasch, not the 13/15 census; Mathon-Rosa 'Small STS and their properties' (Ars Comb. 1982/1983) is the closest small-order property table but no live source located publishes the certified 13/8 spectrum with replayable block lists plus named 0/105 witnesses and checker provenance. Internal Resultary SCOPE036 already stores the same base blocks {0,1,4},{0,2,9}+{0,5,10} as cyclic STS(15) A (|Aut|=60, 11 parallel classes, 0 resolutions), but its datum is resolvability, not Pasch=0; block-list reuse as an explicit construction does not anticipate the certified Pasch invariant. PG(3,2)=105 is brute-force certified here and was not found published as a per-class datum in the searched slice. The new mathematical content is the exact invariant package itself, not certification alone.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of natural objects, motivated before computation: STS(13)/STS(15) are the first two complete non-trivial slices above the Fano plane (2 and 80 classes); Pasch extremals feed the recognized anti-Pasch boundary (v=7,13 exceptions) and resolvability/transversal studies stated in motivation. Values were not known or mechanically implied: counts 2/80 do not imply Pasch 13/8/0/105; non-existence of anti-Pasch STS(13) only implies min>=1, not the spectrum; existence of anti-Pasch STS(15) does not supply the explicit certified witness. A future researcher can directly cite/reuse: STS(13) Pasch spectrum 13 vs 8 with Aut 39/6 and representative block lists; one explicit anti-Pasch STS(15) block list (0 Pasch, Aut 60, cyclic-A isomorphism type) as extremal/reference example; PG(3,2) reference (105 Pasch, Aut 20160) as high-Pasch benchmark; plus stdlib solver/checker benchmark instances. This is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration: objects, invariants, Aut orders, SHAs, and interpretation (0 is absolute minimum; 105 is attained reference, not claimed maximum) are all explicit with machine-checkable certificates. The admittedly incomplete 80-class census is described honestly and does not erase the independently valuable exact headline result.
